disclaimer: This rubric is authored by the Tark team from the bank policy manual and case trigger semantics. It is a detail/self-consistency signal, NOT independent judge ground truth. The headline evaluation metrics are the independent policy-invariant conformance and graded partial credit reported in analysis/evaluation_summary.json.
methodology: Independent, human-authored expected primary next-best-action for each benchmark case, derived from the case trigger semantics, the documented fraud typology, and the bank policy manual (Rules R1-R10). These expectations are authored independently of the agent's emitted output and are NOT read from cases/*.json. The evaluation harness compares the agent's actual primary action against this rubric.

HHG-001.rationale: Thin single-signal model alert (risk 0.61, in-region). Posterior is uncorroborated across evidence families and the decision gate is locked; R1/R9-thin mandate a non-punitive monitor/verify posture, not a terminal block or case escalation.

HHG-002.rationale: Elevated model score (0.79) with no corroborating graph dimension. Corroboration contract withholds an automated confirmed_fraud determination; monitor and gather corroborating evidence.

HHG-003.rationale: Inbound cardholder denial (customer report). Rule R2 mandates card block plus internal case creation.

HHG-004.rationale: Inbound cardholder denial (customer report). Rule R2 mandates card block plus internal case creation.

HHG-005.rationale: Shared-device multi-card ring observed on a low-confidence alert. Rule R6 mandates case creation, connected-card monitoring, and L2 syndicate reporting.

HHG-006.rationale: Cardholder denial with corroborating shared-device ring. Rule R2 governs (block + case + L2 report + connected-card monitoring).

HHG-007.rationale: High-confidence anomalous velocity on an undocumented typology. Rule R9 mandates case creation, L2 filing, and analyst escalation.

HHG-008.rationale: Cardholder denial with corroborating shared-device ring. Rule R2 governs.

HHG-009.rationale: Cardholder denial with proxy-detected infrastructure. Rule R2 governs.

HHG-010.rationale: Shared-device syndicate ring with high exposure. Rule R6 mandates case creation and L2 syndicate reporting.

HHG-011.rationale: Micro-authorization card-testing sequence detected. Rule R5 governs the transaction-level decline (with consequential card block for exposure over $100).

HHG-012.rationale: Weak single signal in the indeterminate band. Rule R1 mandates customer verification before any punitive action, with card monitoring.

HHG-013.rationale: Shared-device multi-card ring. Rule R6 mandates case creation and L2 syndicate reporting.

HHG-014.rationale: Analyst-referred syndicate ring spanning dozens of independent card accounts. The scale (>= 10 accounts) mandates Level-2 human authorization before any SAR filing (R6-syndicate exception); the case is escalated to a fraud analyst rather than auto-filed.

HHG-015.rationale: Shared-device multi-card ring. Rule R6 mandates case creation and L2 syndicate reporting.

HHG-016.rationale: Cardholder denial with corroborating shared-device ring. Rule R2 governs.

HHG-017.rationale: Shared-device multi-card ring on a moderate model alert. Rule R6 mandates case creation and L2 syndicate reporting.

HHG-018.rationale: Inbound cardholder denial. Rule R2 mandates card block plus internal case creation.

HHG-019.rationale: High model score but no corroborating graph evidence family; the decision gate is locked by the corroboration contract. Monitor and corroborate rather than punish.

HHG-020.rationale: Out-of-band customer verification returned an explicit denial, corroborating the alert. Rule R2 mandates card block.
